checks.note: Seagrape Fiduciary Services Ltd. as trustee of The Mahogany Bay Trust holds 50,000 of 50,000 shares (100%) of Mahogany Bay Holdings Ltd., matching Recital (B) of the deed.

Trustee: Seagrape Fiduciary Services Ltd., CIMA trust licence T-0731 (its two signatories sign as authorised signatories, not controllers). Protector: Malcolm Ebanks-Thornton since the deed of 5 Feb 2024, which removed Augustine Rivers-McLaughlin, the protector named in the 2019 deed.

Settlor Isabela Duarte Kimura and current protector Malcolm Ebanks-Thornton. Beneficiaries are a class (children and remoter issue) with nobody named in the deed; Luca and Helena Duarte Kimura appear only in the non-binding letter of wishes and are identified when a distribution is made.
Certified passports for the settlor (certified 12 Oct 2026, expires 18 Jun 2030) and the current protector (certified 29 Sep 2026, expires 2 Apr 2028). No ID is needed for the retired protector.
No watchlist matches for the settlor, protectors past or present, trustee or underlying company.
Licensed Cayman trustee, irrevocable discretionary trust, no PEP; standard CDD.
